evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Build scalable data transformations and automated data quality processes.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeatedly emphasize data quality, governance, documentation, and testing frameworks with no velocity/speed language present, placing this at rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Siemens Healthineers is a medical technology company where core products affect clinical decision-making, but this specific role (Customer Service Data team) works on internal reporting/analytics rather than direct patient-facing or regulatory-reporting systems, placing this at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Engineers; BI Developers; business stakeholders
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named 'Customer Service Data Team' with an existing Snowflake/Power BI/dbt stack already in use is described as being extended toward AI-powered reporting, indicating a growing but already-established data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and develop analytics-ready data models and semantic layers in Snowflake.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name specific tools (Snowflake, Power BI, dbt) and concrete technical scope (semantic layers, standardised KPIs, data governance) that show what the role does day to day, though phrasing stays fairly general throughout.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with Data Engineers, BI Developers and business stakeholders to deliver meaningful insights.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on building the internal data modeling/semantic layer and self-service analytics infrastructure for internal data consumers rather than one specific commercial, product, or finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Drive data governance, documentation and business-friendly data definitions.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines governance/standards ownership (strategic-leaning) with building specific data models and pipelines in response to business needs (execution), making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role: building scalable data models, semantic layers and automated data pipelines that power reporting, dashboards and next-generation AI solutions
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build the data infrastructure (semantic layers, pipelines) that downstream AI-powered reporting and 'next-generation AI solutions' consume, the defining signal of ai_enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines, transformations and testing frameworks.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing frameworks and data quality processes are named as an owned responsibility with explicit action verbs (build, maintain), not just a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Drive data governance, documentation and business-friendly data definitions.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data governance and reliability are named as ongoing secondary concerns without regulatory or stakeholder-trust framing dominating the JD, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: help transform data into trusted insights that drive business decisions... You'll play a key role in building the foundations for advanced analytics, self-service reporting and AI-driven decision-making
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes new-build language (building the foundations for advanced analytics, AI-driven decision-making) with improve/maintain language (improve data reliability, performance and automation) roughly evenly, making this mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: Improve data reliability, performance and automation across the analytics ecosystem — a secondary operational-quality concern, not a dominant compliance risk register.
